2292-6972-8329--225.easyPrerequisites: The Zombie Cat doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and has base toughness 2 or greater.
2292-6972-8329--225.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Zombie Cat.
When the Zombie Cat dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Zombie Cat enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on either a Zombie or Cat you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.
2292-6972-8329--225.notes: You can use either Olag and Miau trigger to put a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat. The other ability can put the counter on any Zombie or Cat you control depending on which trigger is left.

1987-6259-7487.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-6259-7487.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-6259-7487.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

670-1619-4142-6151.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-4142-6151.description:
Cast Hostage Taker by paying its mana cost.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Underdark Explorer until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, causing Underdark Explorer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Underdark Explorer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Hostage Taker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Underdark Explorer until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Repeat from step 5.

4068-4499-6723-7393.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
4068-4499-6723-7393.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

2445-3062-3099-4762.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Pir and Branching Evolution.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2372-2898-6871-7090.description:
Activate Ba Sing Se's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, earthbending Aeon Engine, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Aeon Engine by tapping and exiling it.
Ba Sing Se triggers, returning Aeon Engine from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Aeon Engine ability, reversing the turn order.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph and Wilderness Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Toph trigger, earthbending Aeon Engine.
Resolve the Wilderness Reclamation trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Pass the turn to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Aeon Engine by tapping and exiling it.
Toph triggers, returning Aeon Engine from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Aeon Engine ability, reversing the turn order.
Repeat during your next turn
2372-2898-6871-7090.notes: This loop is written if you want the player before you in turn order to have turns. If you want the player that comes after you to have turns, wait until that player's turn and then start the loop at least 9.

1475-2438-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control another nonland creature with power 1 or greater that does not have One with the Kami attached to it.
1475-2438-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control with power 1 or greater.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and One with the Kami trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the land's power.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1563-3480-3490-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1563-3480-3490-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

1446-7009-7012.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1446-7009-7012.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

64-2792-3647.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
64-2792-3647.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Warden of the Eye and Great Whale
When Warden of the Eye and Great Whale enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
64-2792-3647.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Great Whale.

4338-4875-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Conspiracy, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1651-2797-4659-4772.description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Servos, untapping Retrofitter Foundry.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Retrofitter Foundry's first ability to untap it and get infinite untapped Servo tokens.

1491-4289-6218-6627.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-4289-6218-6627.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-4289-6218-6627.description:

Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2511-2577-6462.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.

1659-2178-5627.easyPrerequisites: Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
1659-2178-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1659-2178-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wight of the Reliquary triggers, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Resolve the Wight of the Reliquary ability from step 1, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

293-5220-5686-5716.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Narcomoeba.
When Narcomoeba dies, Selhoff Occultist and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Narcomoeba from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Selhoff Occultist trigger, causing you to mill Narcomoeba from the top of your library.
Narcomoeba triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1
Repeat.

2866-3836-4970-5751--49.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding an artifact land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to draw a card.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning an artifact land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1445-1913-4871-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one artifact creature card in hand.
You have at least one artifact creature card in your graveyard.
1445-1913-4871-5256.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding an artifact creature card, returning another artifact creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a Necron Warrior.
When the Necron Warrior dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Necron Warrior's power.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2816-3944-4763.description:
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Blood Pet.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Koll triggers, returning Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
Repeat.

3330-4186-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
3330-4186-4279.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Leyline of Vitality trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

151-618-908-2302.description:

Tap the copy to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
Cast To Arms! untapping all your creatures.

1055-1200-1636.notablePrerequisites:
At least one creature you control does not have summoning sickness.
NOTE: This combo can only persist as long as a creature card is milled with each iteration; as such, the more creatures you can tap, the lower your chances of failure.
1055-1200-1636.description:
Activate all creatures you control by tapping them.
Resolve the first creature's ability, causing target opponent to mill cards equal to the creature's toughness.
For each creature card milled this way, Undead Alchemist triggers, exiling that card and causing you to create a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
If a Zombie is created, it enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2 for each remaining trigger.
Repeat from step 1.

2034-2961-3175.description:

When Sun Titan dies, False Demise triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.

2174-3478-3525.notablePrerequisites:

Pemmin's Aura attached to Juniper Order Druid.
2174-3478-3525.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
